headline: Marriott (MAR) Stock Could Stay Pricey As Revenue Miss Tests Outlook
summary: Marriott International has delivered a strong 174.2% share price return over the past 5 years, yet both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiple checks currently point to the stock trading at a premium rather than as a clear bargain. With the price at US$353.91 and recent news highlighting both growth projects and operational headwinds, investors are weighing how much optimism is already reflected in Marriott's valuation.
